_comment: Guided tour of the Terminal and Python Terminal plugins (shared app). Targets are the toolbar item_rects of TerminalApp; awaited steps wait for the user to press the real button.

steps.title: Panes, like tmux
steps.text: This tool shows sessions as panes: tabs, side-by-side splits and floating windows. Each pane is either a real shell or ChiSurf's Python console. The toolbar above controls them.

steps.title: Open a pane
steps.text: New opens another pane of the same kind as the one you are in. Ctrl+T does the same.

steps.title: Choose the kind of pane
steps.text: Python opens the built-in Python console, which already knows the open datasets and fits. The shell pane runs your own shell on a pseudo-terminal.

steps.title: Split the active pane
steps.text: Split divides the active pane so two sessions are visible side by side. The stacked variant sits next to it.

steps.title: Close a pane
steps.text: Close ends the active pane's session and removes the pane. Ctrl+W does the same. A pane whose process already exited stays visible until you close it.
